meta.title: Add TanStack Virtual to documents table for vertical virtualization
meta.body_summary: Adds @tanstack/react-virtual to implement vertical virtualization in the documents DataTable, claiming improved mobile performance and scrollability for large tables.

perf_labels.notes: Devin attempted to add TanStack Virtual to documents table; no formal reviews, only 'resolve merge conflicts' request, closed without merge after ~9 days.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 3580 changed lines, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, but the high deletion count is largely due to a backend directory rename/removal during merge. The core addition of TanStack Virtual is concentrated in DataTable.tsx (~500 lines). The PR was closed without merge, consistent with lack of review and inability to resolve merge conflicts.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer slavingia requested to resolve merge conflicts on May 15; Devin performed a merge commit and attempted fixes but PR was eventually closed without further review.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve mobile performance by adding TanStack Virtual vertical virtualization to the documents table.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed ~4 days after merge conflict resolution attempt; no maintainer approval or review discussion.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding a frontend virtualization library is within Devin's capability, but the PR failed to gain maintainer traction, possibly due to missing performance evidence and a complex merge conflict that wasn't fully resolved.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after metrics, profiler output, or benchmark provided; only narrative claim of improved mobile performance.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no regression issue reported, but the feature was not accepted.

core_change_summary.description: Added @tanstack/react-virtual dependency, modified DataTable component to support optional vertical virtualization via useVirtualizer hook with overscan=10, and enabled virtualization on the documents page. Also resolved merge conflicts from main branch which brought backend directory restructure.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The majority of file changes are from a merge commit that renamed the backend directory from apps/rails to backend and removed numerous GitHub-related files.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: added TanStack Virtual dependency and implemented virtualization in DataTable and documents page.
Devin merged main branch (large restructuring) to resolve merge conflicts.
Devin fixed linting errors and made virtualization optional.
